_sourcing_note: The 6 entries below were sourced from Wikimedia Commons by Claude on 2026-08-10 (public domain / CC0 / CC-BY-SA-3.0 only), with license and direct-file-URL verified per file via WebFetch on each Commons file page before inclusion. Each downloaded image was also visually re-checked with the Read tool after running the script. This is still worth a human glance before it ships to real students -- see the chat summary for exactly which file pages were checked.
